title: Shane Gillis’ Live Comedy Tour: How to Get Affordable Tickets Online
summary: The comedian goes on the road across the United States in 2026.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Comedian Shane Gillis is on the road in 2026. Dates start on Thursday, Jan. 22 with three shows at Madison Square Garden in New York City, while his last tour date takes place on Friday, July 17 at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

Shop Shane Gillis Tickets at Ticketmaster

Since many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, one of the best ways to find Shane Gillis tickets online is through third-party sites, including StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek and others — all of which guarantee authentic tickets in time for the event.

In addition, tickets are all delivered digitally, so you can get them sent instantly to your smartphone or email. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Shane Gillis Live Tour Tickets Online

Looking for cheap seats to see Shane Gillis live? Here’s where to find tickets still available and on sale online.

Find Shane Gillis Tickets at StubHub

StubHub has Shane Gillis tickets available . StubHub’s Fan Protect Guarantee ensures valid tickets or your money back. And if your event is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% in credit or be given the option of a full refund.

EARN REWARDS

Find Shane Gillis Tickets at Vivid Seats

FIND TICKETS HERE

You can also find Shane Gillis tickets online at Vivid Seats , which lets you search by price, location and “Super Sellers,” which denotes reputable sellers with the best deals on tickets.

Vivid Seats is great for group tickets: the site has a rewards program that gives you your eleventh ticket free (in the form of a credit) after you buy 10 tickets online. And as a bonus, you can use our exclusive promo code BB30 to take $30 off your purchase at VividSeats.com .

BEST PRICES

Find Shane Gillis Tickets at SeatGeek

One of the lowest prices we’re seeing for Shane Gillis tickets is at SeatGeek , which has stubs from $50 and up. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODES

Find Shane Gillis Tickets on TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has tickets to Shane Gillis’ concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). For a limited time, you can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off $500 or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.
